name: Cedar compilation and review
goal: Write a concise report compiling the fictional Cedar maintenance access arrangements. Include scope, supplied arrangements and their limits; cite sources. Reuse suitable saved materials. Obtain an independent review of the saved report and select it for delivery. The agreed scope is daytime access only: night-time routing is explicitly outside scope, not a missing deliverable. No new design or engineering sign-off.

sources.title: Project scope
sources.content: Cedar maintenance report compiles the supplied daytime pedestrian access arrangement during the maintenance week. Structural assessment and night-time arrangements are outside scope.

sources.title: Confirmed arrangement
sources.content: During the maintenance week, from 08:00 to 17:00 pedestrians use the east footpath. The west footpath is closed during maintenance.

existing_artifacts.title: Verified supplied access note
existing_artifacts.body: During the maintenance week from 08:00 to 17:00, pedestrians use the east footpath; the west footpath is closed [access]. This compilation does not cover night-time arrangements or structural assessment [brief].
